title: chicken with tie
description: ads chickens and chickens with ties.
body: this mods adds chickens, ties and chickens and ties. you can craft a tie with 3 wool stacked on each other in a crafting table. if you combine wool and an egg you get a chicken with a tie spawn egg. litterally just a chicken with a tie. it does nothing else lol![how to craft a tie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c3ac00078a6bb52467053173dd1f68fbba051aa.png)
